name: KU Leuven
summary: Flemish research university in Leuven; seven English-taught bachelor's in Leuven and Brussels, two of them joint European degrees.

ib.text: The IB Diploma gives access; no points minimum is published. It exempts you from an English test for most programmes if at least half your courses were in English. No 2027 deadlines yet.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
programmes.ib: Every applicant takes the faculty's free online maths test and uploads the result.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Engineering
programmes.ib: Joint degree with UCLouvain Saint-Louis. Maths AA HL strongly advised; every applicant takes the faculty's free online maths test.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology
programmes.ib: Prove maths with SAT (730 maths), ACT (32) or OMPT-D (60%), or sit the non-binding positioning test on the Group T campus in early July.

programmes.name: Bachelor of European Studies
programmes.ib: Joint Una Europa degree across two or three universities; selective: writing assignment, video pitch, possible interview. English test required even with the IB.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Philosophy
programmes.ib: Reading and writing assignment, CV and motivation letter. English test (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90); the IB does not exempt you.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Theology and Religious Studies
programmes.ib: Writing sample, motivation letter and CV; you may apply without an English test, and the faculty judges your English from the file.

programmes.name: Joint Bachelor in Sustainability
programmes.ib: Una Europa joint degree; you apply through Jagiellonian University in Kraków and sit a proctored online entrance exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: KU Leuven sets a deadline per programme in its application-window tool, which as of September 2026 offers no 2027-28 year; for 2026-27 the EEA deadlines ran from 1 April (European Studies) to 1 July (Business).
Almost all other KU Leuven bachelor's are taught in Dutch; for those, EEA applicants have no application deadline.
